blurb: Hausdorff measure and dimension, iterated function systems, Julia and Mandelbrot sets, chaos and multifractals.

pics.alt: Sepia oval portrait photograph of Felix Hausdorff in profile, wearing a suit and tie
pics.caption: Felix Hausdorff, photographed between 1913 and 1921. In 1918 he introduced the measures and the notion of dimension now named after him, which assign non-integer dimensions such as log 2 / log 3 to the Cantor set.
pics.title: Hausdorff 1913-1921.jpg

pics.alt: Bifurcation diagram of the logistic map, plotting long-run values of x against the parameter r from 2.4 to 4
pics.caption: Bifurcation diagram of the logistic map x ↦ r x(1 − x) for 2.4 ≤ r ≤ 4. The attracting fixed point splits into a 2-cycle at r = 3 and a 4-cycle at r = 1 + √6 ≈ 3.449; the doublings accumulate near r ≈ 3.5699, beyond which chaotic bands alternate with periodic windows such as the period-3 window opening at r = 1 + √8 ≈ 3.828.
pics.title: LogisticMap BifurcationDiagram.png
